title: EXCLUSIVE Vietnam with Fansipan Mountain Trek & Cave Excursion
highlights: Embark on a journey through time and nature: explore Hanoi's history, cruise through Halong Bay's landscapes, and immerse in Sapa's hill tribe culture.
Explore Ninh Binh by cycling to Bich Dong Pagoda and visit the ancient Hoa Lu temples
Trek 3 kilometres from Sa Pa to Cat Cat Village through rice terraces, immersing yourself in the local (Hmong) culture, visiting Tien Sa Waterfall, and exploring local handicraft shops.
Enjoy a thrilling cable car ride to the peak of Fansipan (3,147.3 m) the highest point in Vietnam, Laos, and Cambodia.
Set off on a cruise through the UNESCO-listed Halong Bay, a paradise with 1,969 limestone islands & islets, and emerald waters.
overview:
About the Tour:
Northern Vietnam is a great place for a relaxing vacation, with its stunning limestone cliffs, archipelagoes, blue waters, and endless green rice paddies. The place also has a rich history and vibrant culture. For adventurers, climbing Fansipan, the highest peak in the Indochinese peninsula, offers amazing views of green mountains. Enjoy a day cruising in Halong Bay, a beautiful area with limestone islands and turquoise waters, where you can take part in various activities. Experience Vietnam's culture by trying local foods and shopping at the famous night market in the old colonial quarter. This tour of Vietnam has something for everyone.

know_before_you_go: Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.

ID Proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and upon arrival. PAN Card will not be considered as a valid identity proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your upper arms and legs covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
Always carry tissue paper or wet wipes with you as most public toilets in Vietnam do not provide them.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly in Vietnam. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
Images are only for representation purposes.

In cases of force majeure events (e.g., natural disasters, political unrest, or other unforeseeable circumstances), [Thrillophilia] reserves the right to reschedule tours & treks or offer alternative itineraries to ensure the safety and well-being of clients and staff.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Vietnam! Upon arrival at Noi Bai International Airport in Hanoi, get transferred to the hotel and check in. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy at leisure by exploring local attractions on your own. Visit Hoan Kiem Lake, Ngoc Son Temple, and 87 May Street, among others. In the evening, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Hm Boutique Hotel Hanoi at 02:00 PM

days.title: Excursion to Ninh Binh City
days.desc: Begin this day with a transfer for a day trip to Ninh Binh city. Visit Hoa Lu and its ancient temples of the Dinh and Le Dynasties. Following that, explore the limestone caves of Tam Coc, on a boat ride from Hao Lu. From there, enjoy a cycling adventure to Bich Dong Pagoda before getting transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Sa Pa | Trek to Cat Cat Village
days.desc: On this day, check out of the hotel, and get driven to your hotel in Sa Pa. Then, embark on a nearly 3-km downhill trek through rice terraces to Cat Cat Village, home to the Black H'mong ethnic group. Learn more about their rich culture and immerse yourself in the natural beauty surrounding the Tien Sa Waterfall. Conclude your day by trekking back to the hotel in Sa Pa, for an overnight stay.

days.title: Fansipan Mountain Tour | Transfer to Hanoi
days.desc: Embark on a thrilling day trip to Fansipan, the 3,147-metre-high mountain, also called 'Roof of Indochina' as it is the highest peak in Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia. Soar above the clouds on a cable car ride and enjoy views of breathtaking mountain scenery. Also, visit the Kim Son Bao Thang Temple situated at the top of the mountain. Post that, return to the hotel in Sa Pa before checking out and transferring to Hanoi for an overnight stay.

days.title: Hanoi to Halong Bay Overnight Cruise
days.desc: After checking out and getting transferred from the hotel. Embark on a cruise through the iconic limestone karsts of Halong Bay, boarding at Tuan Chau Harbour. Stop by Ti Top Island and Pearl Farm Village, and enjoy water activities like kayaking. Learn the art of Vietnamese cuisine with a cooking demonstration onboard. Conclude your day with an overnight stay on the cruise, surrounded by the breathtaking beauty of Halong Bay.

Hanoi to Halong Bay Overnight Cruise on a Shared basis
items.desc:
Board the cruise for Halong Bay from Tuan Chao Harbor and check-in into your cabin. Enjoy the scenery while sipping the welcome drink. Reach Tiptop Island and relax.
Explore Pearl Farm Village by boat and enjoy water activities like Kayaking and swimming in the bay. Return to the cruise. Afterwards, join the cooking classes on Vietnamese-styled food.
Enjoy the overnight stay at the cruise.

days.title: Halong Bay to Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Start your day with an exciting Tai Chi (martial art) lesson before exploring the awe-inspiring Sung Sot Cave, the largest in Halong Bay. Then, deboard at Tuan Chau Harbour and get transferred to the hotel in Hanoi to check in. Spend the rest of the day at leisure by exploring the place on your own. Immerse yourself in the city's history with visits to iconic landmarks like Temple Of Literature and Hanoi Opera House. Conclude the day by returning to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Halong Bay Cruise on a Shared basis
items.desc:
Enjoy your journey by joining the Tai Chi lesson on the cruise. Explore the other parts and islands of Halong Bay.
Experience a boat ride to the Surprise Cave, the largest cave in Halong Bay and admire its scenic beauty.
﻿Return to the cruise, relax and enjoy before reaching Taun Chan Bay.
